_metadata.description: Enthalpy of formation (meV/atom) of the lowest-energy binary compound relative to the pure elements, as published by Troparevsky et al. (2015). Used by M6 (Troparevsky) and M7 (Senkov & Miracle, Eq. 9).
_metadata.source: M.C. Troparevsky, J.R. Morris, P.R.C. Kent, A.R. Lupini, G.M. Stocks, Phys. Rev. X 5 (2015) 011041, Supplemental Material Appendix A (30 x 30 HEA matrix) and Fig. 1.
_metadata.storage: Upper triangle in the published element order (Mg, Al, Sc, Ti, ..., Pt, Au): value stored under the element that appears first. Lookup is symmetric.
_metadata.asymmetric_entry_rule: The published matrix is not symmetric for 7 pairs. The value printed in the row of the element that appears first in the published order is used. Supporting evidence: Senkov & Miracle (2016) Table 1 dH_IM of CoFeMnMoNi (-16.63 kJ/mol) is reproduced only with Mn-Mo = -138 (Mn row), not -136 (Mo row). With this matrix 44 of 45 Senkov & Miracle dH_IM values are reproduced exactly.

known_suspicious_values.note: Values kept exactly as published because the authors' own predictions (Troparevsky Table I: FeCoNi+Mo predicted multiphase; Senkov & Miracle Table 1 dH_IM) were computed with them. Several look implausibly large and may be unit/transcription errors in the publication; they are flagged in CALCULATION_AUDIT.md for review.
known_suspicious_values.Fe-Nb/Fe-Mo/Fe-Ta/Fe-W origin: sigma/mu phases taken by the authors from Ansara et al. (CALPHAD 1997)
known_suspicious_values.Ti-Cr/Cr-Zr/Cr-Nb/Cr-Hf origin: Laves phases taken by the authors from X.Q. Chen et al., Phys. Rev. B 71 (2005) 174101

data_quality.note: The published matrix is a colour-scaled FIGURE (Supplemental Material Fig. 1), not a table, so every cell was transcribed by eye. Values are NEVER replaced, clamped or interpolated here. Cells outside the figure's own legend range are recorded as suspect: they are still used, but models 6 and 7 mark any verdict they drive as 'data_suspect' so an artefact-derived result cannot be mistaken for a publication-defined one. Replacing the dataset with a corrected matrix requires no model change - delete data_quality.suspect_override below and swap the cells.
data_quality.guard_justification: Two independent bounds. (1) The figure's legend spans about -500..+300 meV/atom. (2) For any alloy, |dHmix| = 4*|sum_{i<j} c_i c_j dH(ij)| <= 2*max|dH(ij)|, and the largest dHmix published anywhere in the eight-model corpus is 29.97 kJ/mol (Yang & Zhang Table 2), so a cell above ~1000 meV/atom cannot contribute to any published dHmix. 700 meV/atom is the conservative midpoint: it flags every known concatenation artefact and leaves all 348 plausible cells untouched.
data_quality.anchor_source: Troparevsky et al. (2015) Section 3 prose / Section 4. These three are the only cells that can be verified without the figure, and they are asserted exactly in the test suite. Mn-Ni additionally determines the hf_min that makes M6 call CoCrFeNiMn a solid solution.
data_quality.suspect_override_note: Fe-Nb, Fe-Ta, Al-Cd are caught by out_of_range_guard_mev anyway; Fe-Mo (-484) and Fe-W -554) are inside the figure range but far outside the physical envelope, and the publication attributes them to sigma/mu-phase data from Ansara et al. (1997). They stay flagged until re-transcribed.

_metadata.replaces: data/binary_formation_enthalpy_data.json previously contained an unverified matrix attributed to 'Morris et al. (2020)' that differed from the publication in 15 cells (including sign changes for Ti-La and Mo-Zn) and failed to reproduce 9 of 45 Senkov & Miracle dH_IM values.
